method: Fresh-context adversarial verification, independent of the prior _rev-w3s4 attempt: G1 artifact exists/non-empty/parses/not-self-blocked; G2 program-canonical receipt schema validation (platform/lib/receipt_schema_gate) plus declared output_schema resolution, with strict class-substrate conformance recorded as informational; G3 sha256 (CRLF to LF normalized) vs UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST primary row and canonical receipt row; G4 dual-receipt-layer state capture; G5 both named probes re-run live (exit 0 plus SUCCESS sentinels), 24/24 green.

Verdict: headline survives as an honest snapshot census; drift recorded as residual_unknown in the closure receipt.
falsification_record_AUD_0072.instrument_hygiene: per single-signal discipline, the first failing instrument was diagnosed as the detector's scope error before any conclusion was drawn

findings.detail: None of the 12 shard units' artifacts or receipts fully conform to the strict generated class substrate (platform/schema/artifact-class-profiles.schema.json requires receipt_core fields plus report{kind,observations,control_ids}); artifacts carry domain payloads without receipt_core fields, receipts pass receipt.schema.json but lack the report payload. Program-wide the substrate IS widely conformed to (85/97 audit artifacts, 519/1153 receipts carry report payloads), so this shard's wave predates or skipped the convention. Recorded as informational; the program's own canonical instrument (receipt_validate C2 plus condition-4) gates the receipt level and passes 12/12.

receipt_schema_gate condition-3 hashes RAW disk bytes while the unit contract mandates CRLF to LF normalization; artifacts 0057/0066/0072 are fully CRLF on disk (identical LF-normalized content), so cond-3 reports mismatch where the contract reports match. Contract semantics used for verdicts; instrument divergence recorded. Recommend the gate gain an eol-normalization mode.

Five SUBAGENT-RETURN receipts (AUD-0044, 0055, 0064, 0071, 0075) sat in the forbidden state=SUCCESS with reviewer verdict=NOT-REVIEWED / independent=false shape before this run; all six repaired (plus AUD-0072's probe-named self-certifying block). All 12 units are now coherent SUCCESS/PASS/independent=true on both receipt layers.
